properties.name: Tarfaya Wind Farm
properties.description: Africa's largest wind farm at commissioning. Located on the Atlantic coast near Tarfaya, it exploits capacity factors exceeding 40% on consistently strong trade winds. Operated under a 20-year PPA with ONEE.

properties.name: Tensift Wind Farm (Essaouira)
properties.description: Part of Morocco's Integrated Wind Programme. The Essaouira coastline benefits from strong Alizé trade winds with speeds exceeding 9 m/s at hub height. The site coexists with local tourism and agriculture in one of Morocco's most culturally significant regions.

properties.name: Akhfennir Wind Farm
properties.description: Located in the Guelmim-Oued Noun region on the southern Atlantic coast. Part of the first phase of Morocco's Integrated Wind Programme. The site anchors the southern half of the Atlantic wind corridor.

properties.name: Taza Wind Farm
properties.description: Located in the Rif mountain foothills near Taza, this project exploits a topographic wind acceleration corridor. The first wind farm in Morocco's interior, demonstrating that viable wind resources extend beyond the Atlantic coast.

properties.name: Boujdour Wind Farm
properties.description: Commissioned in the southern provinces near Boujdour. This site demonstrates the exceptional wind resources of the Saharan Atlantic coast, with capacity factors among the highest in Africa. A precursor to much larger planned developments in the region.
